Also, remove all entries related to iCloud and Ubiquity. Leave the rest of the code unchanged. Then, send me the complete modified code directly here in the chat. Do not add a DOCTYPE or any similar declarations - only include the part of the code that I have provided.) now paste that into a file named "entitlements.xml" or use textastic app to do it. sign in esign with that new entitlements.xml
